content: Achaea and IRE GMCP docs identify Char.Skills, Char.Items, Room, Char.Status, Char.Vitals, and IRE.Display as GMCP modules relevant to boop. Achaea Char.Items includes room/inventory list, add, remove, and update messages keyed by location and item ids; Room.Info carries the current room identity; IRE/Nexus docs warn module names are case-insensitive while JSON key names are case-sensitive.
